title: Structural Metal Fabricators and Fitters
description: Fabricate, position, align, and fit parts of structural metal products.

tasks.text: Verify conformance of workpieces to specifications, using squares, rulers, and measuring tapes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on dimensional measurement of workpieces

dwas.name: Measure dimensions of completed products or workpieces to verify conformance to specifications.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Study engineering drawings and blueprints to determine materials requirements and task sequences.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Parse specs and materials from orders

dwas.name: Read work orders or other instructions to determine product specifications or materials requirements.
Review blueprints or other instructions to determine operational methods or sequences.

tasks.text: Position, align, fit, and weld parts to form complete units or subunits, following blueprints and layout specifications, and using jigs, welding torches, and hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Aligning parts for assembly needs hands and judgment

dwas.name: Operate welding equipment.
Align parts or workpieces to ensure proper assembly.

tasks.text: Lay out and examine metal stock or workpieces to be processed to ensure that specifications are met.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Material product inspection is physical and sensory

dwas.name: Inspect metal, plastic, or composite products.
Lay out parts to prepare for assembly.

tasks.text: Tack-weld fitted parts together.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual welding requires dexterity and live judgment

dwas.name: Operate welding equipment.

tasks.text: Move parts into position, manually or with hoists or cranes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Rigging and lifting loads with cranes is hands-on

dwas.name: Lift materials or workpieces using cranes or other lifting equipment.

tasks.text: Set up and operate fabricating machines, such as brakes, rolls, shears, flame cutters, grinders, and drill presses, to bend, cut, form, punch, drill, or otherwise form and assemble metal components.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Grinding requires hands-on control and feel

dwas.name: Operate grinding equipment.
Operate cutting equipment.

tasks.text: Position or tighten braces, jacks, clamps, ropes, or bolt straps, or bolt parts in position for welding or riveting.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mounting workpieces is physical loading

dwas.name: Mount materials or workpieces onto production equipment.

tasks.text: Lift or move materials and finished products, using large cranes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Rigging and lifting loads with cranes is hands-on

dwas.name: Lift materials or workpieces using cranes or other lifting equipment.

tasks.text: Set up face blocks, jigs, and fixtures.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mounting tools requires hands-on setup

dwas.name: Mount attachments or tools onto production equipment.

tasks.text: Align and fit parts according to specifications, using jacks, turnbuckles, wedges, drift pins, pry bars, and hammers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Aligning parts for assembly needs hands and judgment

dwas.name: Align parts or workpieces to ensure proper assembly.

tasks.text: Hammer, chip, and grind workpieces to cut, bend, and straighten metal.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Grinding requires hands-on control and feel

dwas.name: Shape metal workpieces with hammers or other small hand tools.
Operate grinding equipment.

tasks.text: Locate and mark workpiece bending and cutting lines, allowing for stock thickness, machine and welding shrinkage, and other component specifications.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Drawing guide lines on materials is hands-on

dwas.name: Draw guide lines or markings on materials or workpieces using patterns or other references.

tasks.text: Remove high spots and cut bevels, using hand files, portable grinders, and cutting torches.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Grinding requires hands-on control and feel

dwas.name: Smooth metal surfaces or edges.
Operate grinding equipment.

tasks.text: Smooth workpiece edges and fix taps, tubes, and valves.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hand finishing of metal edges with tools

dwas.name: Smooth metal surfaces or edges.

tasks.text: Mark reference points onto floors or face blocks and transpose them to workpieces, using measuring devices, squares, chalk, and soapstone.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Drawing guide lines on materials is hands-on

dwas.name: Draw guide lines or markings on materials or workpieces using patterns or other references.

tasks.text: Design and construct templates and fixtures, using hand tools.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Generates template designs; aesthetic fit needs human review

dwas.name: Design templates or patterns.
Construct patterns, templates, or other work aids.

tasks.text: Direct welders to build up low spots or short pieces with weld.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Directing production operations is human supervisory authority

dwas.name: Direct operational or production activities.

tasks.text: Heat-treat parts, using acetylene torches.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Heating workpieces requires physical operation

dwas.name: Heat material or workpieces to prepare for or complete production.

tasks.text: Straighten warped or bent parts, using sledges, hand torches, straightening presses, or bulldozers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Reshaping metal requires hands-on machining

dwas.name: Reshape metal workpieces to established specifications.

tasks.text: Erect ladders and scaffolding to fit together large assemblies.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Erecting temporary structures requires physical assembly

dwas.name: Assemble temporary equipment or structures.

tasks.text: Preheat workpieces to make them malleable, using hand torches or furnaces.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Heating workpieces requires physical operation

dwas.name: Heat material or workpieces to prepare for or complete production.

tasks.text: Install boilers, containers, and other structures.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Electromechanical assembly requires hands-on fitting

dwas.name: Assemble electromechanical or hydraulic systems.

emerging_tasks.task: Troubleshoot and repair electrical or mechanical equipment.
